integrity: Exact characteristic and eigenvector-recursion proof; 23 finite symbolic/numeric assertions corroborate selected cases but are not a proof for all sizes. Full historical originality and independent validation have not been established.
scientific_limitations: The all-size result assumes a homogeneous even ring, equal real nearest-neighbor hopping, diametrically opposite imaginary gain and loss, zero magnetic flux, and fixed nonnegative gain/loss strength. It does not classify disorder, flux, asymmetric placements, nonlinearities, or perturbation stability.
title: Embedded exceptional points and parity-graded amplification in antipodal gain–loss rings
